item.title: Aoashi (German Dub) - Episode 6 - First Fan
item.description: Heartened by Noriko's support, Ashito sets his foot in Tokyo City Esperion once again. A couple of Esperion fans speak to him before he is reunited with Ohtomo and Tachibana. Yuma and Asari, who are promoted from the junior youth, join them at the dorm, but one new member hasn't shown up.

item.title: Aoashi (German Dub) - Episode 7 - The First Youth Match
item.description: Fukuda suggests that Ashito and other new Esperion Youth players play an intrasquad game. Anyone who proves their worth in the game will be promoted to the A team. All new players are excited at the prospect of joining the A team. Ashito, playing his favorite forward position, starts the game out well. However…

item.title: Aoashi (German Dub) - Episode 8 - Night Training
item.description: The intrasquad game will determine who gets promoted to the A team. However, no one is passing the ball to Ashito, who is not able to communicate with his teammates through his soccer. He stands in the middle of the field, unable to do anything. Date says that Ashito lacks "individual tactics" to keep up with the constant change of play. Akutsu, a senior player who attacked Ashito at the tryouts, appears in front of him after the game.

item.title: Aoashi (German Dub) - Episode 9 - A Broader Soccer
item.description: Ashito is having a hard time mastering the basic “kill it, then kick it” technique. Seeing the look of desperation on Ashito’s face as he heads out to a solo nighttime training, Togashi agrees to teach him the true meaning of the “kill it, then kick it” technique. However, Togashi’s explanations are abstract and vague. They get frustrated at each other, but Ashito gets a hint when Togashi finally demonstrates it.

item.title: Aoashi (German Dub) - Episode 10 - No Compromises
item.description: In the unusual mini game of 11-on-21, Ashito completely loses the trust of Kuroda and Asari for lack of cooperation. Date gives Ashito the assignment to figure out why they got mad at him. While the others enjoy the only day off of the week, Ashito sets out to practice alone, not being able to find the answer. Then, a sudden visitor appears.

item.title: Aoashi (Spanish Dub) - Episode 11 - Tokyo Metropolis League Match 1 - Seikyo High School
item.description: Tokyo Metropolis League has opened. Ashito and others have their first official match against Seikyo High, but the mood of the team has been awful since the fight on the day of the entrance ceremony. The Esperion Youth B team struggles to coordinate, despite being chosen as a starter, Ashito hasn't found the answer to Date's assignment. Frustrated, Taira suggests that the first-year players switched out.

item.title: MF GHOST Season 3 - Episode 34 - The King's Impatience
item.description: Kanata and Ren struggle with their feelings, while Beckenbauer realizes he has been tricked.

item.title: MF GHOST Season 3 (English Dub) - Episode 31 - The End of Summer
item.description: A friend of Kanata's from England arrives in Japan to compete in MFG, and Aiba crashes the beach party.

item.title: Crunchyroll Presents: The Anime Effect Season 2 - Episode 50 - Anime Tattoo Tour with WNBA Star Gabby Williams!
item.description: Seattle Storm forward Gabby Williams takes a break from the WNBA court to gab about her gateway anime, what she’s watching now and why she fell in love with anime. PLUS she builds her DREAM TEAM made up of her favorite anime characters.
